rationale: Certification risk remains unresolved on K3: all four core methods are qualified open there, so neither a certification loss nor uniform simplification safety is established. K1 is mixed across Seeds: MS2 saves 8.127 seconds at Seed0 but is 0.241 seconds slower at Seed1. Against that retained mixed evidence, K2 supplies the bounded repeated signal: both methods certify at each Seed, and MS2 saves 75.359 seconds at Seed0 (7.1%) and 285.841 seconds at Seed1 (29.6%). Those are two matched observations on one known role, not population evidence. MD-R establishes a legal control, not a performance victory: it is 0.883 seconds faster than MB on K1, 0.556 seconds slower on K2, and both are open on K3; no MB split occurs. Current MB/P remains two Wins and one BOTH_OPEN comparison, with no claimed advantage over the strongest possible tuned compact baseline. The K2 support signal warrants only a single future uniform confirmation design, while the frozen full M-B remains the sole paper method.
